{{Quote|We are ''[&hellip;]'' an Empire ruled by a new Constitution!|[[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]|<ref name="Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith (novelization)">[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'' novelization]]</ref>}}
The '''Imperial Charter''', also known as the '''Constitutions of the New Order''',  was a document outlining the principles of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] [[Politics/Legends|government]]. It served as a guideline for legal statutes concerned with constitutional law invested in the Empire. The Imperial Charter effectively superseded the [[Galactic Constitution/Legends|Galactic Constitution]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as part of several major changes were made for the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]], including the nature of the executive branch, military and law enforcement, the [[Rights of Sentience]], the [[Emergency Military Powers Act]], and [[Decree 77-92465-001]].<ref name="Children">[[Children of the Jedi (novel)|''Children of the Jedi'']]</ref>

One of the charter passages stated that [[Senator/Legends|senators]] could not question an edict of the [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]]. It also included segments detailing the relationships (including political, military, colonial, transportation, and economic) between the Imperial government and the local [[Star system/Legends|systems]] it ruled.

[[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] considered the Empire's use of energy weapons on a primitive species such as the [[Coway]] a gross violation of the Imperial Charter, but acknowledged that by this time, the Empire was largely unconcerned with maintaining such appearances.<ref name="Splinter">''[[Splinter of the Mind's Eye]]''</ref>
